rules.condition: Day is a two-character nonnumeric string or year is a four-character nonnumeric string.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: isNaN(strmm || strdd || stryyyy) tests only the first truthy component; coercive comparisons and Invalid Date allow nonnumeric day/year to pass.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Parse each component strictly as digits before calendar construction.

rules.condition: Any Part III or Part V computation has a nonzero centavo component.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Every formula calls toFixed(0), discarding centavos before currency formatting.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Calculate and round to two decimal places.

rules.condition: Email field contains a valid-looking address as a substring plus surrounding junk.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The regular expression is not anchored, so substring matches pass.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require the entire normalized value to be a valid address.

rules.condition: A Validate-only field such as ZIP, email, location, relief choice, payment choice, or Part V completeness is invalid.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Save checks only date, RDO, name, address, and contact number.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use one phase-aware validation graph.

rules.condition: A legitimate populated Part V row contains zero in any of the three CPP columns while computed bill is nonzero.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please complete row #{row} in Page 2 Part V.
rules.official_behavior: The completeness predicate treats numeric zero as missing, so legitimate zero-valued columns cannot coexist with a nonzero row.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Track presence separately from numeric value.

rules.condition: The eFPS path dereferences IDs and arrays copied from unrelated income-tax schedules.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The source references many controls and AddRow functions absent from 2200C; the path is internally stale and was not exercised.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a revision-specific typed transport mapping after separate online certification.
